## Independent Build 35 manager verification checkpoint — 2026-11-02

Read-only GitHub + retained evidence review at **PR646 HEAD `ae2035b6ddd27e699890c3f12c6ff8edf8d6782a`**. This comment is a **verification and reconciliation proposal**, not a new release/audit PASS or an edit to the central matrix.

### Exact-SHA CI independently read back
- Mobile integration `892f9ef08b29bbce68edffb96298b0a8bf65814a`: all 28 current check-runs completed with **no failed/pending** (conditional skips preserved). Actual Project job [125538558108](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41521548368/job/125538558108) prints **11,447 Node pass and 1,591 backend pass /0 fail**.
- Canonical backend `26d5fae291ffcdbb1a56e312524013c6939ab152`: all 23 current check-runs completed with **no failed/pending** (conditional skips preserved). Actual Project job [125549042756](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41524621274/job/125549042756) prints **8,562 Node pass and 1,575 backend pass /0 fail**.
- Evidence PR646 at `ae2035b6`: all 54 current check-runs completed with **no failed/pending** (including conditional skips). Actual Project job [125553946225](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41526051934/job/125553946225) reports **11,448 Node pass, 1,591 backend pass /0 fail**; that is the evidence branch, not a newly certified mobile release.
- F024 canonical [PR681](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/pull/681) independently confirmed merged: reviewed `f8d7f61cf6d5f75b966d8ea44a27a3ad8d5effe4` -> canonical `26d5fae2`. Patch fixes `duplicate_replay` by denying dispatch with `allowed:false` and `reservationId:null`, and adds five actual handler/SQL-adapter regression tests. No PR reviews or open review threads. **Mobile convergence remains pending**; no deployed-runtime claim.

### Original mandatory matrix: independent parse
- `mandatory-hostile-probes.json` fetched by blob SHA `d12c0a927f60f506f6df7e72d7286c44d90bb779`: **3,096 rows /72 features x43 probes**; sequential IDs 3,096/3,096; **136 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2,959 NOT TESTED**; every existing PASS has an evidence string.
- Venue classifications: **137 prior-executed (includes one FAIL), 318 explicit N/A, 2,356 local, 272 synthetic Staging, 8 external sandbox, 4 device, 1 signed-artifact**. The 2,637 pending applicable calculation is inventory, not bugs. The signed-artifact and four device cases belong to later QA per owner scope.
- **Packing** original 43 rows independently reconcile to **15 PASS /11 explicit N/A still marked NOT TESTED /17 remaining software NOT TESTED**. The 12 composed HTTP/handler/UI records are present and PASS, but overlapping populations must not be added to matrix totals.
- **Live Camera VTO** original 43 rows remain **43 NOT TESTED**; separately, `live-source-executed-probes-1102.json` has **40/40 source PASS**. These are *not* the same 43 assertions. The evidence-source commit `560028ef3f5327989077b19ee6ccbba34f344927` is an ancestor of mobile `892f9ef0`; the one-commit comparison changes tests/governance/manifest, not Live runtime implementation paths. Source evidence can be reconciled only per exact actor/boundary/expected/actual/result; no blanket PASS. Some generic Live cells may be N/A at the UI-only boundary, subject to exact contract review and preservation of lower-layer tests.
- Archive integrity index has **390 records**. I verified its metadata record count; **I have not independently downloaded/decompressed/rehashed all 390 archives**, so archive-byte integrity remains attributed to the original handoff, not this check.

### Management disposition
**AUDIT INCOMPLETE / no release promotion.** Preserve PR646 as OPEN/DRAFT/HOLD; do not merge its large evidence diff automatically. Keep one writer for F024 mobile -> F025 quota authority -> B004 Scanner. My parallel lane is coverage/evidence reconciliation and exact-SHA CI; I have not modified source, shared audit matrix, migrations or runtime. Existing stale master/physical-wearable draft PR failures are separate from the Build 35 integration readiness queue. No CI retry was needed for the three exact-SHA authorities above.
